## InDiCo spillover & Psychometric profile

```{r Indico spillover & psychometric profile}
indico_psy <-read.csv("../data/indico/psychometric_scores.csv") %>%
  mutate(subj = paste0("zh", subj)) %>%
  drop_na()

memorypca <- prcomp(indico_psy[, c("MUmean","OSmean","SSmean","SSTMRelScore")], scale. = TRUE)
indico_psy$memory <- memorypca$x[, 1]
readingpca <- prcomp(indico_psy[, c("SLRTWord", "SLRTPseudo")], scale. = TRUE)
indico_psy$reading <- -readingpca$x[,1]
intelpca <- prcomp(indico_psy[, c("MWTPR", "RIASVixPR", "RIASVix", "RIASNix", "RIASNixPR", "RIASGix", "RIASGixPR")], scale. = TRUE)
indico_psy$intelligence <- -intelpca$x[,1]
cogcontrpca <- prcomp(indico_psy[, c("StrAccuracyEffect", "SimAccuracyEffect", "StrRTEffect", "SimRTEffect")], scale. = TRUE)
indico_psy$cogcontr <- -cogcontrpca$x[,1]

indico_rt_profile <- read.csv("../data/fit_input/et_indico.csv") %>%
  left_join(indico_psy, by = "subj") %>%
  drop_na()
  
# View(indico_rt_profile)

# write_ipc_file(indico_rt_profile, "../data/fit_input_arrow/indico_incl_profile.arrow")
```

```{r}
for(mes in c("gaze_duration")) {
    
  temp_df <- indico_rt_profile %>%
    filter(measures == mes) %>%
    filter(value > 0)
    
  # Fit the model for RT measures
  model <- brms::brm(
    value ~ 1 + len + freq + surp + prev_len * (memory + reading + intelligence + cogcontr) +
     prev_freq * (memory + reading + intelligence + cogcontr) + 
     prev_surp * (memory + reading + intelligence + cogcontr) + 
    (1 + len + freq + surp | subj_id) + (1 | text_id),
    data = temp_df,
    chains = 4,
    family = gaussian(),
    warmup = 1000,
    iter = 2000,
    file = paste0("../models/psycho-profile/", "indico_profile_ms_", mes),
    cores = 4,
    backend = "rstan",
    silent = 0,
    # prior = priors_rt
  )
}

print("Done fitting models")
```

```{r}
temp_df <- indico_rt_profile %>%
  filter(measures == "gaze_duration") %>%
  filter(value > 0)

profiles <- c("reading", "memory", "intelligence", "cogcontr")
spillovers <- c("prev_len", "prev_freq", "prev_surp")

# profiles <- c("reading")
# spillovers <- c("prev_len")

interactions <- list()


for (prof in profiles) {
  for (spil in spillovers) {
    message("Processing: ", prof, " × ", spil)
    
    mu <- mean(temp_df[[prof]], na.rm = TRUE)
    sdv <- sd(temp_df[[prof]],   na.rm = TRUE)
    prof_vals <- c(mu - 2*sdv, mu - sdv, mu, mu + sdv, mu + 2*sdv)
    spill_seq <- seq(
      min(temp_df[[spil]], na.rm = TRUE),
      max(temp_df[[spil]], na.rm = TRUE),
      length.out = 100
    )
    newdata <- expand.grid(
      spill   = spill_seq,
      profile = prof_vals
    )
    for (p in setdiff(profiles, prof)) {
      newdata[[p]] <- mean(temp_df[[p]], na.rm = TRUE)
    }
    for (s in setdiff(spillovers, spil)) {
      newdata[[s]] <- mean(temp_df[[s]], na.rm = TRUE)
    }
    newdata$len       <- mean(temp_df$len,       na.rm = TRUE)
    newdata$freq      <- mean(temp_df$freq,      na.rm = TRUE)
    newdata$surp      <- mean(temp_df$surp,      na.rm = TRUE)
    newdata$subj_id   <- NA
    newdata$text_id   <- NA
    names(newdata)[names(newdata) == "profile"] <- prof
    names(newdata)[names(newdata) == "spill"]   <- spil

    if (any(duplicated(names(newdata)))) {
      stop("Duplicate column names in newdata: ",
           paste(names(newdata)[duplicated(names(newdata))], collapse = ", "))
    }
    # preds <- posterior_linpred(m, newdata = newdata, re_formula = NA)
    preds <- posterior_epred(m, newdata = newdata, re_formula = NA)
    newdata <- newdata %>%
      mutate(
        estimate      = apply(preds, 2, mean),
        sd_pred       = apply(preds, 2, sd),
        lower         = estimate - sd_pred,
        upper         = estimate + sd_pred,
        # lower = apply(preds, 2, quantile, 0.25),
        # upper = apply(preds, 2, quantile, 0.75),
        profile_var   = prof,
        spillover_var = spil
      )
    interactions[[paste(prof, spil, sep = "_x_")]] <- newdata
  }
}

# quick sanity checks
length(interactions)                  # expect 12
sapply(interactions, nrow)  

interaction_df <- bind_rows(interactions, .id = "interaction_id")
nrow(interaction_df)  # expect 12 * 500 = 6000

# write_csv(interaction_df, "../results/stats/interaction.csv")
```

```{r}
profiles   <- c("reading", "memory", "intelligence", "cogcontr")
spillovers <- c("prev_len", "prev_freq", "prev_surp")

spill_labels <- c(
  prev_len  = "Standardized Word Len. (n-1)",
  prev_freq = "Standardized Lexical Freq. (n-1)",
  prev_surp = "Standardized Surprisal (n-1)"
)

profile_pretty <- c(
  reading      = "Reading Fluency",
  memory       = "Working Memory",
  intelligence = "Intelligence",
  cogcontr     = "Cognitive Control"
)

for (profile in profiles) {

  dfp <- interaction_df %>%
    filter(profile_var == profile) %>%
    mutate(
      spillover_var = factor(spillover_var, levels = c("prev_len","prev_freq","prev_surp")),
      x = case_when(
        spillover_var == "prev_len"  ~ prev_len,
        spillover_var == "prev_freq" ~ prev_freq,
        spillover_var == "prev_surp" ~ prev_surp,
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      ),
      profile_level = {
        vals <- .data[[profile]]
        lvls <- sort(unique(vals))
        if (length(lvls) == 5) {
          factor(vals, levels = lvls,
                 labels = c("-2 SD","-1 SD","Mean","+1 SD","+2 SD"))
        } else {
          factor(vals)
        }
      }
    )

  p <- ggplot(dfp, aes(x = x, y = estimate, color = profile_level, fill = profile_level)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
    facet_wrap(
      ~ spillover_var,
      nrow = 1,
      scales = "free_x",
      labeller = labeller(spillover_var = spill_labels),
      strip.position = "bottom"
    ) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = "log(Gaze Duration)",
      color = profile_pretty[[profile]],
      fill  = profile_pretty[[profile]]
    ) +
    # coord_cartesian(ylim = c(5.3, 5.8)) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      legend.position      = "right",
      legend.title.align   = 0.5,
      strip.placement      = "outside",
      panel.grid.major.x   = element_line(linewidth = 0.2, colour = "grey85"),
      panel.grid.major.y   = element_line(linewidth = 0.2, colour = "grey90"),
    ) +
    guides(
      fill  = "none",
      color = guide_legend(
      title.position = "top",
      label.hjust    = 0.5
      )
    )

  outfile <- paste0("../visualization/paper/psych/interaction_", profile, ".pdf")
  ggsave(filename = outfile, plot = p, width = 8, height = 2, dpi = 300)
  message("Saved: ", outfile)
}

```


```{r}
spillovers <- c("prev_len", "prev_freq", "prev_surp")
profiles   <- c("reading", "memory", "intelligence", "cogcontr")

# Updated facet labels
profile_labels <- c(
  reading = "Reading Fluency",
  memory = "Working Memory",
  intelligence = "Intelligence",
  cogcontr = "Cognitive Control"
)

spill_labels <- c(
  prev_len  = "Standardized Previous Word Length",
  prev_freq = "Standardized Previous Word Frequency",
  prev_surp = "Standardized Previous Word Surprisal"
)

# Exact x-axis text requested (uses “Lexical Frequency” and the en dash minus n−1)
spill_xlab <- c(
  prev_len  = "Standardized Previous Word Length",
  prev_freq = "Standardized Previous Lexical Frequency",
  prev_surp = "Standardized Previous Surprisal"
)

for (spill in spillovers) {
  dfs <- interaction_df %>%
    filter(spillover_var == spill) %>%
    mutate(
      profile_var = factor(profile_var, levels = profiles),
      x = case_when(
        spillover_var == "prev_len"  ~ prev_len,
        spillover_var == "prev_freq" ~ prev_freq,
        spillover_var == "prev_surp" ~ prev_surp,
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      )
    ) %>%
    group_by(profile_var) %>%
    mutate(
      vals = case_when(
        profile_var == "reading"      ~ reading,
        profile_var == "memory"       ~ memory,
        profile_var == "intelligence" ~ intelligence,
        profile_var == "cogcontr"     ~ cogcontr,
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      ),
      profile_level = {
        lvls <- sort(unique(vals))
        if (length(lvls) == 5) {
          factor(vals, levels = lvls,
                 labels = c("-2 SD","-1 SD","Mean","+1 SD","+2 SD"))
        } else {
          factor(vals)
        }
      }
    ) %>%
    ungroup()

  p <- ggplot(dfs, aes(x = x, y = estimate, color = profile_level, fill = profile_level)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
    facet_wrap(
      ~ profile_var, nrow = 1, scales = "free_x",
      labeller = labeller(profile_var = profile_labels)
    ) +
    labs(
      x = spill_xlab[[spill]],
      y = "log(Gaze Duration)"
      # no title
    ) +
    theme_light() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      strip.text = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),  # Increase facet label size
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray85", color = "black", linewidth = 0.4)
      )

  outfile <- paste0("../visualization/paper/psych/interaction_", spill, ".pdf")
  ggsave(filename = outfile, plot = p, width = 8, height = 3, dpi = 300)
  message("Saved: ", outfile)
}
```
